positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Pennsylvania Department of Transportation
Senior Programmer/Analyst   (February 2003 – December 2009)
· Initially involved in the maintenance of the legacy ECMS (Engineering and Construction Management System) application using Visual Basic 6.0 (Microsoft Visual Studio), Lotus Notes 6.5 and DB2.  

Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC)
Programmer/Analyst   (June 1999 – May 2002)
· Analysis, design and lead developer of client server application integrating Microsoft Outlook custom forms, Visual Basic 6.0 and SQL server database for a mobile application for building, elevator and asbestos inspectors for the PA Department of Labor and Industry.  
· Requirements gathering and communicating with end-users.


EDS
Programmer/Analyst  (August 1998 – April 1999)
· Development and maintenance of IMS batch and MPP programs within the TSO environment of an IBM 3090 MVS mainframe for the Bethlehem Steel account.

· ECMS was scheduled for a multi-phase re-write starting in the spring of 2006.  Involved in Analysis, Design, Development, Unit Testing and Integration of the project, which was developed using J2EE (JSP, Servlets, Business Objects) technology with a custom framework developed by Bearing Point.  Wrote SQL queries for DB2 database access.  
· Continued with maintenance of the ECMS application after implementation.
· Familiar with WebSphere v6.0 Server for use of localhost debugging for unit testing.
· Used Rational ClearQuest extensively as a Change Management Tool and Issues tracking tool.
· Used Rational Clear Case for version control management.
· Requirements gathering and communicating with end-users.

positions.title: Project Leader/ Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
· Worked as a senior member of the Point-of-Sale register team that is used by over 8,000 stores.  Development was completed in Micro Focus Cobol under MS-DOS. Worked extensively on credit card processing, which included communication processes with the credit provider. 

· Project Lead/Lead Developer on an Integrated Debit project for Canadian retail stores.  This included analysis and design to integrate the debit peripheral into the current system.  As Project Leader from the Venator side, worked cooperatively to coordinate with two outside vendors.  This included the company, which developed the peripheral device and the bank with whom the debit transactions would be processed.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Bethlehem Steel
Programmer/Analyst
· Responsible for developing a data dictionary for Bethlehem Steel, reviewing programs and copybooks in order to leverage common fields. 
· Development and maintenance of IMS programs.


AMP, Inc.
Programmer/Analyst
· Analysis and new program development of batch COBOL II / IMS programs for AMP’s AMS system.


Meridian Bank
Programmer/Analyst
· Analysis and development of two FoxPro projects for Meridian Bank.  The first project was a mortgage-packaging project to allow bundling when one bank acquired another bank’s mortgages.  The other project was for a “Mass Litigation” project, dealing with disaster situations (i.e. plane crash, etc.) where many people would be file lawsuits in order to claim reimbursement entitlements.


Skandia Insurance
Programmer/Analyst
· Analysis, design and program development for various insurance applications using FoxPro.


Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission
Programmer/Analyst
· Analysis, design and development of the Cash Day Audit project, which kept track of toll fares taken based upon the type of vehicle. Development of application using FoxPro.


Pennsylvania Blue Shield
Programmer
· Program maintenance support on the ICE project using COBOL II in a batch environment.

positions.title: Customer Service Analyst
positions.description:
· Quality Assurance testing and program maintenance of COBOL programs within the TSO/ISPF environment of an IBM 3090 MVS/XA mainframe.  
· Maintenance of project documentation and program specifications.
